title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slipped 2.1% to close at $74,220 as fear hit extreme levels at 22. Sellers dominated the US session with no meaningful bounce into the close. 

Network strength remains intact with hashrate steady at 949 EH/s, while mempool congestion sits at 95k transactions and fees as low as 2 sat/vB. 

Key takeaway: price weakness is not yet reflected in miner behavior or on-chain activity. Overnight watch is any break below 73k that could accelerate liquidations into Asia hours.
